rv.q: What can I say, though? Sometimes a platter of cheese is just what you fancy.

“We don’t need a rocket: our legs can be the rocket,” is an example of the dialogue. “Watching piano keys go up and down/Your music flew above the train into town,” gives you an idea of the lyrics’ inanity. Zheng Xi Yong’s classical piano playing in the lead role of Kо̄sei provides subtlety and real feeling in a welter of phony sentiment.

Fold your arms and harumph and you’ll miss the point; get dizzy recalling that first flush of adolescent desire and the agony of its not being reciprocated, and you’re in. … the songs are plenty good enough to stand on their own two feet. … Mia Kobayashi…radiates superstar power.
